pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.2: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi aṭṭhitā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.3: atha kho aññatarassa daḷiddassa kammakārassa etadahosi: “na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati, yathā ime manussā sakkaccaṃ bhattaṃ karonti, yannūnāhampi bhattaṃ kareyyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.4: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakāro yena kirapatiko tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ kirapatikaṃ etadavoca: icchāmahaṃ ayyaputta, buddha pamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa bhattaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.6: sopi kho kirapatiko saddho hoti pasanno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.7: atha kho so kirapatiko tassa daḷiddassa kammakārassa abbhātirekaṃ vetanaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.8: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakāro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so daḷiddo kammakāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.9: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.12: bahū me badarā paṭiyattā badaramissenapayyā paripūrissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.14: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakaro bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.15: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū daḷiddena kira kammakārena svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito, badaramissenapayyā paripūrissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.17: assosuṃ kho manussā daḷiddena kira kammakārena buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantitoti. te daḷiddassa kammakārassa pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ abhihariṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.18: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi. kālo bhante niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.19: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena tassa daḷiddassa kammakarassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.20: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakaro bhattagge bhikkhū parivisati. bhikkhū evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.22: mā kho tumhe bhante ayaṃ daḷiddo kammakaroti thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭigaṇhittha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.25: na kho mayaṃ āvuso etaṃ kāraṇā thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.26: api ca mayaṃ kālasseva piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjimhā, tena mayaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭiggaṇhāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.27: atha kho so daḷiddo kammakāro ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.28: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā mayā nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.30: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa daḷiddassa kammakārassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.31: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.32: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.33: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjantīti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.36: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.38: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.40: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.2: aññataro bhikkhu piṇḍapātaṃ ādāya yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca: “bhuñjāhi āvuso”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.4: tassa bhikkhuno piṇḍapāto ussūre āharīyittha. so bhikkhu na cittarūpaṃ bhuñji.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.8: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.10: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.11: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvaradānasamaye sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyādetvā bhikkhū nimantenti: “bhojetvā cīvarena acchādessāmā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.6: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.9: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.10.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvarakārake bhikkhū bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.2: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. atha kho te manussā bhagavato ca āyasmato ca ānandassa bhojanaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.9: evañca pana bhikkhave vikappetabbaṃ: mayhaṃ bhattapaccāsaṃ itthannāmassa dammīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.2: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantito taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati, etaṃ paramparabhojanaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.6: na sakkoti ekāsane nisinno yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjituṃ gilānasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.8: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso, atthate kaṭhine pañcamāsā cīvaradāna samayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.11: añcatra samayā bhuñjissāmīti patigaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.1: paramparabhojane paramparabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.2: paramparabhojane vematiko aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.3: paramparabhojane na paramparabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.6: sakalena gāmena nimantito tasmiṃ gāme yattha katthaci bhuñjati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.7: sakalena pūgena nimantito tasmiṃ pūge yattha katthaci bhuñjati,
